title: Qwen-Image 2.1 control: images 2-3 supply the subject
description: Control op on Qwen-Image 2.1 takes optional subject images, as Qwen Image Edit does: image 1 gives the depth/pose/scribble/canny map, images 2-3 who is drawn into it. Graph: a subject-reading encoder feeds the control sampler; models.js declares depthSubject/depthSubject3.
